title: Penalty for arranging for departure through places other than the specified place of departure
chapter: Chapter VIII — Offences, Penalties, and Trial
text: Penalty for arranging for departure through places other than the specified place of departure.— If a person or a recruitment agent arranges for, or assists in departure of a worker from Bangladesh through a place other than the specified place of departure, such an action shall be deemed as an offence, and t he offender shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may be up to ten years, and with a penalty, which shall not be less than Bangladeshi Taka Five Lakh taka.
source: Overseas Employment and Migrants Act 2013 (official English translation)
